company.description:
GUILD is a platform to learn about insurance and find coverage options for the collaborative economy. It aims to help build a global community of entrepreneurs and individuals acting as peers. GUILD does this by making insurance accessible and simple.

GUILD was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
